device_entry.name: 惠普 HP6652A 单路可编程直流电源
device_entry.name_en: HP 6652A Single-Output Programmable DC Power Supply
tags: 电子器件供电与台架测试
device_entry.description: HP 6652A 是一台单路可编程直流台式电源，用于为实验装置、电子电路和原型系统提供稳定的电压与电流输出。它适合实验室中的供电、调试和基础电源测试，并支持输出开关、过压/过流保护以及前面板显示功能。
device_entry.description_en: The HP 6652A is a single-output programmable bench DC power supply used to provide stable voltage and current to laboratory setups, electronic circuits, and prototype systems. It is suitable for powering, debugging, and basic power testing, and supports output enable control, overvoltage/overcurrent protection, and front-panel display functions.
